application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The works have not been described in measurable or quantifiable terms, as required by Government Guidance  BS3998:2010.  Clear measurements (e.g., pre and post work height/width reductions) are required to ensure the Local Planning Authority can assess the impact. Please resubmit with an appropriate specification. For example: 2m crown reduction in width and 2m reduction in height, leaving a canopy spread of 3m and height of 5m. Please refer to the Council’s guidance for full details
description:
two very overgrown trees, holly tree and silver birch so overgrown blocking all light into house
wish to cut back approx height and spread 2/3 meters 
The Holly Tree is approx 25 feet high and 12 feet wide
The silver Birch is approx 30 feet high and 14 feet wide

these trees have not been cared for in years and need some tender loving care please 
There is NO TPO on either two trees had this confirmed by Richmond council
